name: hamen/material-3
description: A Material Design 3 (Material You) skill for Android and Jetpack Compose UI work: design tokens, components, color, and Material 3 patterns, as a user-invokable skill for building compliant, polished Material interfaces.
install: npx --yes skills add hamen/material-3-skill --skill material-3 -y (recommended) and Claude Code plugin route (/plugin install material-3@material-3-skill). Only the current routes are drafted; README notes the older plugin command never worked and is superseded.
